note: SMOKE config. One free model, one rep, one task (SLOPBENCH_TASKS=01-parse-args in CI): two agent runs that prove the key, the CLI image and the grading path in about three minutes. Writes to data/smoke/ and commits nothing. Use it before a full sweep (see .github/workflows/bench.yml, mode=smoke).

variants.vanilla: You are an expert Python developer. Solve the task exactly as specified.
variants.minimal: You write the least Python that fully satisfies the spec. Standard library only. No classes, no abstractions, no comments, no error handling beyond what the spec requires, no extra features. A few clear lines beat a clever framework.
